item.title: Google Launches Universal Gemini AI Agent for Enterprise Work Tasks
item.description:
Google Launches Universal Gemini AI Agent for Enterprise Work Tasks

Google has announced a “universal” Gemini AI agent designed to work across apps and devices in the background to handle enterprise work tasks. Revealed during the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, the agent allows users to assign tasks and chat from a single interface within the Gemini Enterprise app.

🧩 How it works

The new Gemini agent is built to streamline workflows by operating across various environments:

  • Cross-app and device integration: The agent runs directly inside Google Workspace apps like Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar. Users can also interact with it via mobile devices, desktop computers, the web, and third-party platforms such as Slack and Microsoft 365.
  • Cloud-based context: Because it runs in the cloud, Gemini maintains the same context across all connected devices.
  • Smart model selection: Gemini automatically performs tasks using whichever AI model best fits the specific job.
  • Collaborative capabilities: The agent can work alongside job-specific sub-agents to complete tasks, or operate as a “coworker agent” with its own dedicated identity and a custom “@agents.company.com” email address.

🚀 Availability

Currently, the enterprise-focused Gemini agent is only available to enterprise customers in a private preview. It offers an early look at Google’s broader vision of an AI assistant capable of answering questions and executing work from a single window.

This development follows Google’s May launch of the consumer-facing Gemini Spark agent, which subscribers can use to complete tasks across Workspace and the web via a separate interface within the Gemini app.

item.title: Cyara Appoints Ben Corser to Lead APAC Expansion and Announces Agentic CX Summit
item.description:
Cyara Appoints Ben Corser to Lead APAC Expansion and Announces Agentic CX Summit

Cyara, an AI trust company for customer experience, has appointed Ben Corser as General Manager and SVP, Go-to-Market for Asia-Pacific. The move signals an investment in the Australian market and a focus on accelerating growth throughout the region.

👤 Leadership Appointment

Ben Corser joins Cyara following senior leadership roles at several global technology firms:

Company Role Status
NiCE Most recent position
Matterport Previous leadership
SAP Previous leadership
EMC Previous leadership
Nokia Previous leadership
Microsoft Previous leadership

⚙️ Cyara Agentic Platform

Chief Product Officer Amitha Pulijala will present innovations regarding the Cyara Agentic Platform. Key capabilities include:

  • Proving AI agent behavior and end-to-end customer journeys prior to deployment.
  • Maintaining visibility into quality and compliance for live agents.
  • Moving from monitoring agent availability to verifying that agents behave as intended via AI Trust Observability.
  • Scoring every live conversation for quality and compliance.

🚀 Upcoming Regional Events

Cyara plans to engage with the regional market through two upcoming events:

  • Cyara Agentic CX Summit: September 8 in Melbourne.
  • Genesys Xperience APAC: November 11–12 in Sydney.

💡 Why it matters

Cyara currently supports more than 450 enterprises, including significant Australian organizations such as two of the Big Four banks, two national mobile network operators, and the largest supermarket retailer. The platform operates across all major CCaaS providers and supports over 55 AI agent vendors.

#Cyara #CustomerExperience #AIAgents #APAC #EnterpriseTech
